definitions.explanation: The medical procedure of removing surgical stitches or sutures after a wound has healed sufficiently. Also used as a suru verb.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧{抜糸|ばっし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: The stitches are scheduled to be removed next week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{抜糸|ばっし}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had my stitches removed one week after the surgery.

examples.japanese: {抜糸|ばっし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}していた→心配する：06066_shinpaisuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I was worried that having the stitches removed would hurt, but there was almost no pain.

notes:
USAGE:
A medical term commonly encountered in hospital and clinic settings. Used both as a noun and as a suru verb ({抜糸|ばっし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). Patients will typically hear this word when their doctor discusses the timeline for stitch removal after surgery or wound treatment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抜糸|ばっし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to remove stitches)
- {抜糸|ばっし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (the day of stitch removal)
- {抜糸|ばっし}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧ (after stitch removal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{縫合|ほうごう}→縫合：21277_hougou⟧: suturing — the opposite procedure, sewing a wound shut
- {抜釘|ばってい}: removal of surgical pins or screws
